$comment: GDPR (EU 2016/679) → ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A control mappings. Drawn from BSI / ENISA guidance and the widely-published ISO 27701 ↔ GDPR appendix; encoded here directly against ISO 27001 Annex A 2022 IDs because we don't yet ship 27701 in the catalog. Relationships: 'equivalent' for true 1:1 control intent (rare for GDPR — most GDPR articles are organisational and bigger than any single Annex A control), 'partial' for substantive overlap, 'informs' for tangential/supporting alignment.
source: ENISA GDPR-ISO 27001/27701 mapping + BSI 27701 implementation guide cross-walk

mappings.rationale: Privacy and protection of PII — transparency-of-processing notices align with the lawfulness/fairness/transparency principle.
Data-minimisation by design supports the privacy / PII-protection control.
Records protection / retention requirements align with storage-limitation evidence.
Information classification and acceptable use enforce integrity and confidentiality of personal data.
Use of cryptography to protect personal data confidentiality.
Compliance-with-policies/standards reviews demonstrate accountability.
Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements register documents the lawful basis.
Provision of information to data subjects at collection time aligns with PII privacy controls.
Provision of information when data is obtained from third parties.
DSAR-Access workflow operationalises PII-subject rights.
Right-to-erasure operationalised within PII privacy controls.
Information-security policies represent the controller's accountability framework.
Secure development life-cycle embeds data-protection-by-design.
Secure system architecture and engineering principles operationalise privacy-by-default.
Information security in supplier relationships covers processor due-diligence.
Addressing information security within supplier agreements covers DPA contractual flow-down.
Managing information security in the ICT supply chain covers sub-processor management.
Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services maps to processor monitoring.
Inventory of information and other associated assets is the closest analogue to RoPA.
Acceptable-use and classification controls protect personal data.
Information security for use of cloud services protects personal data in cloud processing.
Information security incident-management planning underpins integrity/availability of personal data.
Privileged-access rights protect personal data confidentiality.
Secure authentication protects access to personal data.
Information backup ensures availability of personal data.
Use of cryptography ensures confidentiality of personal data in transit and at rest.
ICT readiness for business continuity supports availability of personal data.
Incident-management planning includes breach-notification timelines.
Assessment and decision on information-security events covers breach categorisation.
Response to information-security incidents covers SA notification.
Information-security event reporting is the first link in the breach chain.
Response to information-security incidents — communication to data subjects.
Threat-intelligence input informs DPIA risk identification.
Information-security roles and responsibilities — DPO is one such role.
Compliance reviews — DPO monitors compliance.
Information transfer (SCCs, BCRs) is captured as transfer-control agreements.
Supplier agreements with appropriate transfer safeguards.
Contact with authorities — covers cooperation obligation with the SA.
